name: Hermit / Opportunist
life_theme: Develop your natural genius in solitude, then share it through your established network.
work_pattern: Need significant alone time to develop natural talents. Resist being pulled out of their natural development too early. When ready, opportunities come through existing relationships.
career_approach: Protect time for solitary development of your natural gifts. When you're called out by others who see your talent, consider it seriously — that's your invitation. Career moves via your network, not applications.
growth_edge: Recognising when solitude has shifted from development to hiding.
